correctness.rationale: For every periodic orbit at exact half-degree contact, counting time-directed transmissions along each edge gives saturation and the pointwise identity A u_t=r(u_{t-1}+u_{t+1}). An elementary root-of-unity algebraic-integer argument excludes all nonconstant temporal frequencies using the exactly computed three-eigenvalue spectrum of T(n), n>=5. A constant excitation indicator must be zero by refractoriness. Exhaustive independent checks at n=5,6 verify sharp times and complete first-extinction histograms.

value.rationale: Triangular/Johnson line graphs are canonical connected strongly regular networks. The activation threshold equals the full induced-edge density, an equality case not reached by a known strict-density extinction theorem. Resolving all periods on this entire infinite family, plus two sharp complete small-order extinction histograms, gives a natural structural boundary and finite benchmarks rather than an arbitrary graph slice.
